status: proposed design, not an executed or preregistered confirmation
title: Chemically constrained hypothesis generation for Bayesian force field repair
hypothesis: Given acquired QM residuals and verified chemistry tools, an LLM can propose useful changes to torsion parameter sharing and representation that a fixed-model acquisition policy cannot propose. Bayesian inference chooses coefficients and QM configurations; data validate every structural edit.

scope.first_stage: Portable periodic torsion terms only; background charges, bonds, angles and nonbonded parameters frozen
scope.baseline: Pin a modern classical force field and disclose its training-record overlap; require new test data outside its fitting set for an OOD claim
actions: propose one validated local SMIRKS specialization
propose shrinkage or harmonic-set revision within 1..6 for one scoped torsion family
request an existing cheap candidate that discriminates two hypotheses
abstain and flag inadequate data or representation
not_allowed: invent force constants or QM labels
change molecular charge/protonation/spin to improve fit
use evaluation labels to accept edits
export unsupported coupling terms as if they were portable
derive exact relaxed-profile symmetry from a local methyl group alone
scope.test_task: Each primary ligand task resets to the same baseline. Only that ligand support QM labels and training-only retrieval enter adaptation. No parameter learning is carried between fresh test tasks; untouched-analogue transfer is secondary and clustered by chemical family.

state: atom-mapped graph and verified parameter assignments
observed QM energies and forces when available
residuals by parameter group and conformer branch
posterior covariance, identifiability and posterior-predictive checks
training-only retrieved QM analogues with source/theory metadata
architecture.llm: Open 7B model with a validated stable compute path and LoRA; constrained JSON program proposals rather than A-E decisions
architecture.critic: Shared candidate-independent utility scorer trained on development rollouts; the identical scorer is used for all proposal generators
architecture.compiler: Validate SMIRKS matching, atom-map/permutation consistency, coverage, term support, parameter count and scope; reject invalid proposals
architecture.bayesian_layer: Fit numerical parameters with priors and compare candidate models using observed-data evidence or nested support-only validation; retain no-edit option. Use shared Bayesian parameter/model-discrimination acquisition for every method
architecture.call_budget: At most two LLM calls per task: after 8 shared support configurations and optionally after 16. At most two nontrivial proposals per call. No per-candidate calls
architecture.latency: Cache graph/tool/retrieval state; score candidates independently; hash semantic programs and tie-break by canonical identity, never displayed position

supervision.labels: Validated edit programs and cost-aware out-of-sample utility from development-only repair rollouts; include no-edit/abstention cases
supervision.grouping: Split molecules, scaffolds and target chemical environments before generating episodes; repeated episodes do not increase independent molecule count
supervision.loss: Program SFT plus regret-weighted candidate utility/preference learning; select checkpoints by downstream cost-error objective, not token loss alone
supervision.counts_status: Targets subject to public-data inventory, overlap audit and development-only power calculation; not a claim that these cohorts have been obtained

data.retired: All current benchmark cohorts are development-only now; no part of the existing inspected scaffold universe is called a new fresh scaffold test
source_candidates: QCArchive/OpenFF records with consistent theory and available QC provenance
SPICE conformers and forces as a separate protocol-specific benchmark
data.qm_protocol: One level of theory per fitted benchmark. Do not pool B3LYP-D3BJ/DZVP and SPICE omegaB97M-D3BJ/def2-TZVPPD labels as the same target
deduplication: nonstereo parent and canonical state identity
baseline and pretrained-GNN fitting-record exclusion where auditable
data.prospective: After retrospective success, about 20 blinded ligands with cheap MM candidate geometries and new QM only on acquired states; actual energy/gradient evaluation counts and core-hours logged. Costs require a concrete compute plan before launch

controls: fixed model plus pure Bayesian acquisition
verified chemistry rules plus the same compiler, Bayesian fitter and acquisition
support-only cross-validation over the same representation library
Bayesian model averaging over an equally budgeted rule-generated hypothesis library
retrieval-only proposal generator with the same tools
learned non-LLM graph/descriptor proposal generator with identical supervision
BespokeFit-style local refitting baseline under the same QM budget
LLM proposals with residual evidence removed (ablation)
model revision with fixed acquired IDs versus model revision plus updated acquisition (factorial ablation)
fairness: Equal support data, QM candidate pool, candidate-hypothesis slots, priors, fit/evidence budget and validation tools. All methods may keep the baseline or abstain. Exact graph symmetry tools are shared, not an LLM-only advantage

evaluation.support_budget: 8 common initial QM configurations, then batches of 4 to 32. A QM gradient calculation counts once as a configuration, not once per force component
evaluation.primary: Campaign-mean held-out centered relative-energy RMSE area under the error-versus-QM-evaluations curve, at budgets 8/16/24/32
evaluation.primary_comparators: Pure Bayes and the strongest non-LLM revision method selected on validation before test
evaluation.target_success: At least 10% lower primary error AUC point estimate versus both primary controls, with both paired 97.5% scaffold-cluster intervals entirely below zero; proposed effect-size gate, not a power guarantee
evaluation.seeds: Three independent fine-tuning seeds and five acquisition seeds; hierarchical uncertainty treats scaffold/molecule as independent units, not trajectories
secondary: total QM core-hours and LLM wall time
evaluation.physical_validation: Off-grid and distinct conformer families; native energy/force comparisons after GROMACS/LAMMPS/NAMD export where engines are available; precision tolerances fixed on controls. Short MD checks are stability checks, not thermodynamic accuracy claims
evaluation.fresh_set_policy: Finalize cohort inventory, power and protocol before any test outcomes; a failed test is reported without retuning on it

gates: On retired development data, verify model-revision headroom with observed-only CV/BMA and transparent hindsight references
Reject representation gains caused only by conformer-branch artifacts or high-frequency overfit using off-grid/force validation
Require proposal validity and semantic permutation invariance before expensive fine-tuning
If rules/CV/BMA explain all useful gains, keep those methods and do not claim an LLM contribution
Run new QM or cloud jobs only after an explicit compute specification and authorized budget
candidate_contribution: Data-efficient, validated model-structure repair and targeted QM experimentation, complementary to graph-to-parameter force fields; novelty must still be established by a focused literature review and comparative results
